title: Nussinov–Jacobson RNA 折叠算法 · 互动教程
text:
RNA 是单链分子——它会自我折叠、链内配对，形成发夹（hairpin）、茎环（stem-loop）、内环与多分支接头等二级与三级结构，而这些结构往往直接决定其功能。Nussinov–Jacobson 算法用动态规划求解「最多碱基配对」这一最优化问题，是理解 RNA 折叠的第一块基石。

RNA is a single strand that folds back on itself — intramolecular base pairing builds hairpins, stem-loops, internal loops and multi-loop junctions that govern its function. The Nussinov–Jacobson algorithm uses dynamic programming to maximise base pairing, the classic entry point to RNA-folding prediction.

title: InsightDerm · 全切片图像的皮肤癌智能诊断（硕士论文）
text:
中文
    EN
  
  硕士论文 · JKU Linz · 人工智能 · 2023
  MSc Thesis · JKU Linz · Artificial Intelligence · 2023




摘要
本研究旨在用深度学习提升基于全切片图像（Whole-Slide Imaging, WSI）的皮肤癌诊断。我们使用了 1108 张 WSI 切片的数据集，类别高度不平衡。我们在双流多示例学习（Dual-Stream Multiple-Instance Learning, DSMIL）框架中引入关键特征自注意力与多头注意力，提出两种新架构，并用稀疏模块改进了 DSMIL Base。
其中 InsightDerm（Top-K 关键特征多头注意力 + DSMIL）在验证集上取得最佳结果；而更简单的 DSMIL Base 在测试集上表现最优。结果表明，把关键特征与多头注意力引入 WSI 诊断系统是有效的。

背景：为什么是多示例学习？
一张 WSI 是千兆像素级的巨幅图像，但通常只有一个切片级标签（良性 / 恶性、亚型）。于是我们把每张切片切成成千上万个小图块（patch），整张切片视为一个「包（bag）」，图块是包里的「示例（instance）」。多示例学习用注意力把图块聚合成切片级判断——而真正起决定作用的，往往只是少数几个关键图块（肿瘤区域）。

方法

  注意力多示例学习：以注意力权重聚合图块特征。
  双流多示例学习（DSMIL）：一条流找「关键示例」，另一条流衡量其余示例与它的关系。
  InsightDerm：在 DSMIL 之上引入 Top-K 关键特征多头注意力——只聚焦注意力最高的若干图块，并用多头机制从多个角度刻画它们。
  骨干网络对比：ConvNeXt、Vision GNN、Visual Attention Network。






Abstract
This work enhances deep-learning models for skin-cancer diagnosis from Whole-Slide Imaging (WSI). Using a dataset of 1108 WSI slides with strong class imbalance, we develop two new architectures by adding critical-features self-attention and multi-head attention to the Dual-Stream Multiple-Instance Learning (DSMIL) framework, and revise the DSMIL Base with sparse modules.
InsightDerm (Top-K Critical-Features Multi-Head Attention with DSMIL) achieved the best results on the validation set, while the simpler DSMIL Base outperformed on the test set — demonstrating the value of critical features and multi-head attention for WSI-based diagnosis.

Background: why multiple-instance learning?
A WSI is a gigapixel image, yet typically carries a single slide-level label (benign / malignant, subtype). So each slide is tiled into thousands of small patches and treated as a bag, with patches as instances. Multiple-instance learning uses attention to pool patches into a slide-level decision — and only a few critical patches (the tumour region) usually drive that decision.

Method

  Attention-based MIL: pool patch features with attention weights.
  Dual-Stream MIL (DSMIL): one stream finds the critical instance, another measures how the rest relate to it.
  InsightDerm: adds Top-K Critical-Features Multi-Head Attention on top of DSMIL — attend only to the highest-scoring patches, characterised from several heads.
  Backbones compared: ConvNeXt, Vision GNN, Visual Attention Network.

    IEEE ICDM 2025
    Sc-GRIP: a Graph Convolutional Approach to Infer Gene Interaction Polarity from Single-Cell Data
    
      Carolina E. Atria, Yitao Cai, Pascal Weber, Anna Beer,
      Nils Kriege, Christian Böhm, Roger Revilla-i-Domingo, Claudia Plant
    
    2025 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM), pp. 1030–1039 · IEEE
    
      Sc-GRIP casts gene regulatory network inference from single-cell data as a
      graph convolutional learning problem, and goes beyond deciding whether two
      genes interact to inferring each interaction’s polarity — whether one gene
      activates or represses another. By propagating expression signals over a learned
      gene–gene graph, it recovers signed, directional regulatory relationships directly from
      sparse single-cell measurements.

title: Sc-GRIP · 从单细胞数据推断基因互作极性
text:
中文
    EN
  
  IEEE ICDM 2025 · 维也纳大学
  IEEE ICDM 2025 · University of Vienna




摘要
理解基因如何被调控，是众多生物学问题的核心。实验与计算方法已经能告诉我们「哪些基因可能相互作用」，但要判断这种作用的极性——究竟是激活还是抑制——却非常困难。我们提出 Sc-GRIP（Single-cell Gene Regulation Interaction Polarity），一个图卷积框架，直接从单细胞 RNA 数据中推断转录因子（TF）与目标基因之间互作的方向性。
Sc-GRIP 把基因表达谱与基因互作图结合起来，学习基因的隐表示，再用一个双线性解码器（bilinear decoder）预测调控极性。该方法可扩展、且可针对特定细胞类型，无需依赖物种特异的先验注释或大量实验验证。

问题
转录因子是一类特殊蛋白，它们结合到 DNA 的特定序列上，决定目标基因被「打开（表达）」还是「关闭」。给定一张已知的 TF–目标基因互作图，图的结构可以从数据直接得到，但每条边的符号与权重却随细胞类型与状态而变，难以推断。Sc-GRIP 要解决三个挑战：

  建模潜在的调控结构；
  推断每条边的标签（激活 / 抑制）；
  对生物噪声与细胞异质性保持稳健。


方法
输入是高维、稀疏的基因表达矩阵与一张无符号的 TF–目标基因邻接矩阵。Sc-GRIP 在图上做卷积、聚合邻居信号，学到每个基因的隐表示；随后用双线性解码器对每条边打分，分数的符号即对应「激活 / 抑制」。由于带标签的极性数据稀少且偏向研究充分的基因，方法采用自监督 / 弱监督的思路，使其能泛化到未见过的转录因子与细胞类型。





Abstract
Understanding how genes are regulated is fundamental to many biological questions. Experimental and computational methods can tell us which genes may interact — but finding the polarity of an interaction (whether it activates or represses) is a non-trivial problem. We introduce Sc-GRIP (Single-cell Gene Regulation Interaction Polarity), a graph convolutional framework that infers the directionality of transcription-factor (TF) gene interactions directly from single-cell RNA data.
By combining gene-expression profiles with gene-interaction graphs, Sc-GRIP learns latent gene representations and predicts regulatory polarity with a bilinear decoder. The method is scalable and cell-type-specific, and needs no species-specific prior annotations or extensive biological validation.

The problem
Transcription factors are proteins that bind specific DNA sequences and decide whether a target gene is switched ON (expressed) or OFF. Given a known TF–target graph, the structure can be read from the data, but each edge's sign and weight are context-dependent and vary across cell types and conditions. Sc-GRIP tackles three challenges:

  model the latent regulatory structure,
  infer the edge labels (activation / repression), and
  stay robust to biological noise and heterogeneity.


Method
The inputs are high-dimensional, sparse gene-expression matrices and an unsigned TF–target adjacency matrix. Sc-GRIP convolves over the graph, aggregating neighbour signals into a latent representation per gene; a bilinear decoder then scores each edge, and the sign of the score gives "activation / repression". Because labelled polarity data are scarce and biased toward well-studied genes, training is self- / weakly-supervised so it generalises to unseen TFs and cell types.

title: 深度表示学习 · 第2章：线性与独立结构
text:
线性与独立结构是表示学习的地基：从 PCA 找主轴，到 ICA 拆出独立成分，再到 稀疏编码 / 字典学习 学到过完备而可解释的基。本篇把 马毅实验室《Deep Representation Learning》第 2 章做成一个可玩的 Pluto + Makie 笔记本——拖动参数，图形即时回应。

Linear and independent structure is the bedrock of representation learning — from PCA to ICA to sparse coding / dictionary learning. This is Chapter 2 of Ma Lab’s Deep Representation Learning, rebuilt as a playable Pluto + Makie notebook where every figure responds to your input.
